title: Synthetic Product Testimonial Example
description: A fictional example of an AI-generated testimonial presented as if it were created by a real customer.
observed: The available content appears to contain AI-generated media and presents a testimonial-style statement.
potential_interpretation: The content may create the impression that a real individual provided the testimonial.
alternative_interpretation: The content may have been created as clearly labeled promotional or illustrative material.
open_questions: Was the synthetic nature of the content disclosed?

title: Personalized Promotional Message Example
description: A fictional example showing how a promotional message could be adapted to a specific audience profile.
observed: The fictional message references preferences that appear tailored to a particular audience segment.
potential_interpretation: The message may have been personalized using information about audience interests or behavior.
alternative_interpretation: The message may simply use broad marketing language designed for a general audience.
open_questions: What information was used to create the personalization?
Was the audience aware of the personalization?
Was AI used to generate or adapt the message?

title: Contextual Image Example
description: A fictional example involving an authentic image presented without important contextual information.
observed: The image appears authentic, but the accompanying description provides limited context about when and where it was originally created.
potential_interpretation: Selective presentation of the image may influence how viewers interpret it.
alternative_interpretation: The missing context may be the result of limited space, incomplete information, or ordinary reposting.
open_questions: What context accompanied the original publication?
